text:
maria: Heads-up — wrapping up the postmortem for the cross-region TLS handshake flaps we saw this morning. Postmortem link: https://redwood.in/pm/4321 :warning:

ashok: thanks. quick recap for folks who missed it: 1) partial certchain mismatch from the rotator hitting some edge LB nodes, 2) control-plane route churn sent traffic across regions, 3) retransmit/retry loops increased tail latency.

kevin: saw the same stack traces in the LB logs — e.g. `tls: handshake error from 10.2.3.45: remote error: handshake failure` repeated during 02:14-02:22 UTC.

olivia: action items we tracked in the postmortem: - ownership for cert rotation validation (Ashok) - LB route stability fixes (Kevin + Jade) - monitoring/recurrence checks (Sam) - runbook updates for cross-region fallbacks (Maria)

ashok: I will own cert validation. Plan: audit the rotation job and add a dry-run verification step that validates the full cert chain on a sample of LB nodes before rollout. Target: ship by EOD Friday.

kevin: Jade and I will triage the routing churn cause. First step is to reproduce the route-eject pattern in staging using simulated control-plane delays. Timeline: reproduce by Tue, patch candidate by Thu.

jade: adding note — we'll also add a guard in the router that prevents async route swaps if the healthchecks spike. Minimal config change, can hotpatch.

sam: I'll own monitoring. Deliverables: 1) alert for TLS handshake errors > 5/min across regions, 2) dashboard for cross-region retry rate, 3) a weekly recurrence detector job that checks for patterns across the last 90 days. ETA: next Wed for alerts/dashboards, weekly job by next sprint.

sre-bot: incident created: INC-2026-4321. Postmortem draft uploaded. Reminder: 72h action-owner check-in scheduled.

maria: runbook updates — I will add a quick triage checklist: `is cert chain complete?`, `is control-plane stable?`, `fallback to local model?` (jk) — seriously: `force local routing`, `bump retry backoff`. Will PR the runbook today.

ashok: quick config snippet we'll add to the rotator job to validate chain (dry-run):
```bash
curl -sf https://lb-node.example/health || echo "bad"
openssl s_client -connect lb-node.example:443 -showcerts | openssl verify -CAfile /etc/ssl/certs/ca-bundle.crt
```

kevin: for the router guard, proposed HAProxy map rule: `map_allow_swap[backend] = if (health_rate < 0.05)`. We'll test in staging first.

olivia: ownership + deadlines consolidated:
- Ashok: cert rotate dry-run + validator PR — due Fri 2026-03-27 :spiral_calendar: 
- Kevin & Jade: routing churn reproduce + patch — repro Tue 2026-03-24, patch Thu 2026-03-26
- Sam: monitoring + recurrence job — alerts/dash Tue 2026-03-24, weekly job Wed 2026-04-01
- Maria: runbook PR — today EOD

maria: please add any blockers in-thread. Also tagging @oncall for cross-region awareness next 48h.

sam: small blocker — need access to historical LB telemetry retention longer than 7d to run recurrence detector. @olivia can you confirm increase?

olivia: yes, I can request the retention bump with infra. Will follow up after sync.

jade: once we have the reproduction, we should run a controlled canary to ensure the hotpatch reduces retries by >50% before rolling to prod.

kevin: agreed. I'll create a tracking card and link to the postmortem. Card: https://redwood.in/cards/RT-2194

maria: 72h check-in scheduled for 1795035521 (thread automated reminder). Everyone please update your sub-tasks on the card before the check-in. :thumbsup:

ashok: noted. I'll post the validator PR link in this thread when ready.

sam: adding a note to monitoring: include a synthetic TLS handshake probe from each region to every other region to catch cross-region cert/path issues early.

olivia: ack. I'll add that to infra requests.

maria: thanks all — this is the follow-up tracker for the postmortem. We'll close items as owners mark done.

kevin: one last thing — log retention/centralization improvements (longer history) is medium priority but will help recurrence detection across months. Marking as infra-req depending on costs.

jade: ok. tagging finance for cost discussion in the card.

maria: closing the loop: next update here after 72h check-in or sooner if we have a patch.

kevin: thanks everyone.
